post.description:
Create a ToDo Item for a specified Project.

This endpoint has been deprecated. Instead, use [/rest/v1/calendar-items)

project_id.description: The ID of the Project the ToDo belongs to

assignment_id.description: The ID of the Assignment of the ToDo

finish_datetime.description: The Finish date-time of the ToDo

private.description: The Private status of the ToDo

start_datetime.description: The Start date-time of the ToDo

todo.description: Use some power tools to fix the drywall.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":1,\"todo\":{\"assignment_id\":1,\"color\":\"#314159\",\"description\":\"Use some power tools to fix the drywall.\",\"finish_datetime\":\"2015-02-07T00:00:00Z\",\"name\":\"Fix drywall\",\"percentage\":99,\"private\":true,\"start_datetime\":\"2015-02-06T00:00:00Z\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/todos", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-code-samples.title: Curl
x-code-samples.content:
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.procore.com/rest/v1.0/todos \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"project_id":1,"todo":{"assignment_id":1,"color":"#314159","description":"Use some power tools to fix the drywall.","finish_datetime":"2015-02-07T00:00:00Z","name":"Fix drywall","percentage":99,"private":true,"start_datetime":"2015-02-06T00:00:00Z"}}'
